verdict.rationale: Statsig documents a first-party choice of storage location: run its features on top of your own data warehouse through Warehouse Native, or host data in Statsig's infrastructure. Keeping data in your own warehouse gives you control over where it resides, but the evidence never mentions region selection or data-residency guarantees for Statsig-hosted data. Missing for 10: explicit region/residency selection (e.g., EU/US hosting), documented residency guarantees or compliance details, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)

citations.quote: You can use any of these features on top of your own data warehouse through Warehouse Native with no extract, transform, and load (ETL).
Or, you can host your data in Statsig's infrastructure.
